David.notable_example: David straightforwardly declared his Villager role and voted Ethan based on genuinely thin reasoning about vague language, fully consistent with his private scratchpad.

Frank.notable_example: Frank deliberately omitted his Doctor role from public discussion while hinting at it by stating he 'protected someone other than David,' a strategic but understandable omission to avoid becoming a Mafia target.
